front.title: Signed Authorization-Evidence Records for AI Agent Actions Using WIMSE Workload Identity

abstract.t:
This companion to the WIMSE AI Identity Management System (AIMS) document specifies how an Issuer records a pre-execution authorization decision for an AI agent using WIMSE workload identity. The signed record, called a Permit, can bind the decision to a canonical request body. For a dispatched allow with a request-body commitment, a paired Closure Record carries the recorded dispatch digest. The profile maps these and related records to the audit requirements in Section 11 of AIMS and describes optional composition with HTTP Message Signatures, OAuth access tokens and Shared Signals Framework events. The companion SCITT profile (draft-munoz-scitt- permit-profile) specifies the Permit and Closure Record.
This revision also describes how WIMSE deployments compose with authorization-lineage evidence defined by the companion SCITT profile: workload identity, delegated subject context, runtime token claims, and HTTP Message Signature coverage become Verifier inputs for parent/child Permit relationships.
